scope.description: A single Raft node whose FSM implements ConfigurationStore, processing a committed LogConfiguration entry. The obligation concerns delivery of the configuration entry to the FSM, not the correctness of the configuration value itself.
assumptions: The entry has been committed (reached the FSM via processLogs).
The FSM implements ConfigurationStore as documented in configuration.go:44-52.
excluded: Whether ApplyBatch is the intended delivery point for batching FSMs is a separate contract question; this claim only asserts the ConfigurationStore contract.
Consensus safety of the configuration entry's commitment rule is out of scope.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: No target protocol logic is altered. The harness only supplies an application FSM that implements FSM, BatchingFSM and ConfigurationStore, and observes what the library delivers to it.
No logging or helper initialization unrelated to the discriminator is added; SnapshotThreshold/SnapshotInterval are raised only so an automatic snapshot cannot interfere with the sampled FSM state.

plan_uncertainties: Whether implementing both BatchingFSM and ConfigurationStore is a supported configuration.
Whether ConfigurationStore is intended to apply only to non-batching FSMs, in which case a negative observation is a contract/documentation gap rather than an omission in delivery.
grounding_unresolved: Whether implementing both interfaces is a supported configuration.
Whether the intended normative reading is that ConfigurationStore applies only to non-batching FSMs.
Whether a FSM implementing both BatchingFSM and ConfigurationStore is a supported configuration or whether the two interfaces are contractually exclusive.
Whether the intended delivery point for batching FSMs is ApplyBatch alone, making the ConfigurationStore comment inaccurate rather than the dispatch incomplete.
